# Endless Auto Collection

> Fremont, CA shop for paint protection film (PPF), ceramic coating, window tint, vinyl wraps, detailing, and mechanical work on European and Japanese performance cars. Every job is documented in photo and video. By appointment only.

Address: 41907 Albrae St, Fremont, CA 94538
Phone: +1 510-709-7097
Service area: Fremont, Newark, Union City, Milpitas, Hayward, East Bay, Silicon Valley

## Services
- [Paint protection film](https://www.endlessautocollection.com/ppf)
- [Ceramic coating](https://www.endlessautocollection.com/ceramic)
- [Window tint](https://www.endlessautocollection.com/tint)
- [Vinyl wraps](https://www.endlessautocollection.com/wraps)
- [Detailing](https://www.endlessautocollection.com/detailing)
- [Mechanical](https://www.endlessautocollection.com/mechanical)

## Pricing (retail, starting points; final price confirmed after inspection; updated November 2026)
- Ceramic coating, paint correction included (we do not coat paint that needs correction): coupe $900, sedan $1,000, SUV $1,200. Coating only on already-corrected paint: by quote.
- PPF (with ceramic coat over the film): front-end $2,200, rear $4,500, full-body SUV $7,000. Sedan and coupe full-body by quote.
- Ceramic window tint: windshield $180, front and windshield $480, front and rear $500, full car with windshield $600.
- Detailing, coupe/sedan/SUV: full detail $140/$155/$185, quick full detail $95/$105/$125, exterior $85/$95/$100, interior $80/$90/$100. Monthly packages, coupe/sedan/SUV: 2 full details $270/$300/$360, 3 full details $360/$400/$480.
- Mechanical: shop labor $150 an hour. 5 year, 50,000 mile mechanical package $3,000, excludes wear and tear.

## Warranty
- PPF and window tint carry a lifetime warranty from the film manufacturer. It covers lifting: if the film lifts, we fix or replace it, depending on the situation.
